rooms.name: The gap
rooms.hint: Asleep, the current carries you. Pinch over the far floor to land. Standing pinched in the exit takes you on.

rooms.name: The soft wall
rooms.hint: Drift through the soft wall. Pinch on the far side, one jump up to the exit; stand pinched in it to go on.

rooms.name: The goat
rooms.hint: Wait for the goat and let it carry you over. Pinch above the far floor; stand pinched in the exit to go on.

rooms.name: Your bed
rooms.hint: Pinch and E to take an idea or push the block. E at your bed wakes you gently with everything.
